tools.description: Use for the synthetic APM Elizabeth driver-induction experiment. Query the server-owned knowledge graph and completion evidence using the user's supplied facts. Missing facts must stay null. The caller cannot supply completion evidence. Returns a single-requirement result, sources, missing facts, and separate unchecked trip coverage. No real driver verification or dispatch clearance. Use when asked whether the synthetic driver has induction, can enter, can dispatch, or can use a route; broader questions will retain a coverage gap.

company_changed.description: Whether the user reports a company change. This does not establish a SeaLink change.

current_sealink_id.description: Current synthetic SeaLink alias; never substitute an old identifier or invent one.

driver_id.description: Synthetic driver alias supplied by the user, not a real driver identifier. Do not guess.

terminal_id.description: APM Elizabeth ID, the synthetic other terminal, or null if unknown.

trip_at.description: Exact supplied trip timestamp including seconds and timezone. Use null if absent; never use today's date to fill it.

observations.source_locator: Archived NJPASS home HTML, Bulletin panel
observations.source_text: Effective August 3, 2026, a section of Port St. will be reduced to one lane in both directions between Brewster Rd. and Marlin St. until further notice. In this section of Port St., lanes will be reduced to 11 feet wide and all oversize loads heading eastbound on Port St. MUST utilize the Corbin St. ramp. All oversize loads heading westbound on Port St. MUST follow the Marlin St. / Kellogg St. detour or utilize Outer Port St. until further notice. All oversize loads MUST exit through the south via North Ave. Please call the Port Authority Police Department (PAPD) at (973) 578-2180 to request an escort for any oversize loads travelling through the port.
